review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer - CCIE Certified
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Purpose The purpose of this position is to support and maintain the network and our customer base. The main focus of this engineer will be implementing and maintaining IP network services and may extend to core routers, switches, servers, and applications, as necessary. Job Responsibilities Installing, configuring and maintaining enterprise level network hardware and applications. Acting as Subject Matter Expert and assisting with technical support issues as and when required Assist Technica
eligibility_evidence: Our Group employs approximately 2000 people from 41 different nationalities, which contributes to our multicultural and multi-national environment.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Preparation / validation of LLD, HLD and other project related documents Any other additional tasks the line manager may give and is within the scope of work Job Requirements Qualifications Graduate / Diploma engineer in Electronics / Telecom / IT/ computer science Experience Minimum 8 years of experience in Enterprise Network Implementation and Support Certifications CCIE, HCIE Certified Engineer Knowledge & Skills Good knowledge in converge network, Wireless, Security, Routers, Switches, Firewall and Network Management Software. Other networking products like HP, Huawei, Cambium will be an added advantage Good implementation and troubleshooting knowledge in at least one firewall product (Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto or Checkpoint) Must have full network lifecycle experience including gathering requirements, test, documentation, configuration and maintenance.
